jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.jobDescription: We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale our payment APIs. You will build microservices in Python (FastAPI) and Java (Spring Boot), own services end to end including CI/CD and monitoring, and work with Kafka for event-driven data sync. 4+ years of production backend experience required. Hybrid role based in Bengaluru.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Remote, India)
jobs.jobDescription: Orbit Labs is hiring a Backend Engineer to build REST APIs and internal developer tooling. Stack: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub Actions. Fully remote within India. You will own the full lifecycle from design through deployment and operations. 3+ years experience with production systems expected.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.jobDescription: MegaCorp Retail seeks a Senior Software Engineer for our Mumbai office (5 days on-site). Java, Spring, Kubernetes, and large-scale order management systems. Relocation to Mumbai required. 5+ years experience. Competitive compensation.
